_comment: window_literals: printable strings in a fixed byte window around the env-block anchor; job is to catch NEW fields cc adds nearby. required_literals: each field template this hook reimplements that window_literals cannot see, mapped to its whole-binary occurrence count at pin time — a changed count participates in Task 6's failure, and the exact number's job in that report is to say what moved. Three blind spots land a literal here: under the {12,} length floor (Platform: 10 chars; the bare Shell: prefix, 7); too far from the anchor for any reasonable window (cTm, ~150M bytes away in a separate embedded copy of the app); or non-ASCII, which forces the whole string to UTF-16 and hides it from the ASCII-only regex even inside the window (the worktree clause's em-dash sits at a byte offset squarely inside the current window and is still invisible). Full derivation, byte offsets, and rejected alternatives: notes/env-context-manifest.md. Do not fold required_literals back into window_literals.
